name: Hirohara Mei
source:
The seventh "rebellion".
Up until the moment she was recently transferred into Kouryoukan Academy, she skipped grades and studied in advanced classes in America.
She has distanced herself from the people around her because they do not understand her and she claims to hate idiots.
Her love for sweet things is possibly related to the fact that she uses her brain a lot, which in turn consumes a lot of calories.
